title: Factorial
code:
# factorial.py
def factorial(n):
    result = 1
    for i in range(2, n+1):
        result *= i
    return result

num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
print(f"Factorial of {num} is {factorial(num)}")

title: Palindrome (Number)
desc: Checks if a number is a palindrome.
code:
# palindrome_number.py
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
original = num
rev = 0
while num > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + num % 10
    num //= 10
if original == rev:
    print("Palindrome")
else:
    print("Not a palindrome")

title: Reverse an Integer
code:
# reverse_integer.py
num = int(input("Enter an integer: "))
rev = 0
n = abs(num)
while n > 0:
    rev = rev * 10 + n % 10
    n //= 10
if num < 0:
    rev = -rev
print("Reversed:", rev)

title: Armstrong Number
desc: Checks if a number is an Armstrong number.
code:
# armstrong.py
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
order = len(str(num))
sum = 0
temp = num
while temp > 0:
    digit = temp % 10
    sum += digit ** order
    temp //= 10
if num == sum:
    print(num, "is an Armstrong number")
else:
    print(num, "is not an Armstrong number")

title: Strong Number Check
desc: Checks if sum of factorials of digits equals the number.
code:
# strong_number.py
def fact(n):
    f = 1
    for i in range(2, n+1):
        f *= i
    return f

num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
temp = num
sum_fact = 0
while temp > 0:
    digit = temp % 10
    sum_fact += fact(digit)
    temp //= 10
if sum_fact == num:
    print(num, "is a Strong number")
else:
    print(num, "is not a Strong number")
